verdict.rationale: MotherDuck is a cloud data warehouse with AI features (Dives, remote MCP server), so a data-training opt-out or no-training commitment is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains no statement about whether customer data is used to train AI models, and no opt-out control. SaaS Mode only limits interaction with the local environment, and read-only MCP access is an access restriction; neither addresses model training.
